# The Humble Co.

> Eco-friendly oral care brand specializing in sustainable bamboo toothbrushes, natural toothpastes, and innovative whitening solutions.

The Humble Co. is a sustainability-focused dental care company offering COSMOS-certified natural products including their flagship Humble Brush 7K, plant-based toothpastes, whitening kits, and eco-friendly accessories. Founded in 2013, the brand prioritizes environmental responsibility through recyclable packaging and PFAS-free formulations.

## Key Topics

- Humble Brush 7K
- Eco-friendly oral care
- COSMOS Natural certification
- Plant-based toothbrushes
- Natural toothpaste
- Teeth whitening
- Sensitive teeth care
- Sustainable packaging
- PFAS-free
- Whitening strips
- Vegan dental products
- Enamel-safe formulas
- Bamboo toothbrush
- Recyclable packaging
- Biodegradable accessories
